verdict.tagline: Free horror classic with terrifying atmosphere and rough technical edges.
for_you_if: you want a deeply atmospheric psychological horror campaign
you enjoy classic puzzle design and backtracking
you appreciate fan-made origins with authentic retro charm
not_for_you_if: you will not install community fixes for modern hardware
you need smooth co-op multiplayer without connection barriers
you dislike getting lost without objective markers

citations.review_text: This game is old and its gameplay is awful; there's nothing new. The number of glitches and annoying things is insane. While trying to get my friend to join, I was attacked and killed in like 10 seconds. This game is not fun. It was a waste of time and space on my laptop. Not recommended.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that some puzzles are confusing and require consulting a video walkthrough to solve.

citations.review_text:
Amazing game ngl. Sure, the voice acting is hilariously bad, and some of the puzzles are so confusing that you need a YT walkthrough in order to solve them. The gameplay is actually really addictive though, and the story was really engaging and made me wanna play more. Its still a real solid game thats worth playing, a lot of the world building reminds me of Max Payne, even though the game was inspired by Silent Hill.
8.8/10

Very good game and story, amazing graphics for a gold source game, ok voice acting, but difficult to even make it run the game, doesn't work well on Win 11 and even on Win 10 while i launch the game i get stuck to a black screen after the team logo and powered by gold source, i tried every fix possible, tried the compatibility mode, changed to Windows 7/Vista and XP Service Pack 3 and 2, run as administrator also tried a supposedly fix from ModDB, still didn't work, and the fix for my case it worked after i disabled my internet, without internet i could launch and play the game, also tried to play this game with my friends on a internet cafe, we could launch the game there without problem but we tried to play the Co-op mod but when someone hosts a game it doesn't show on LAN neither on friends neither, neither couldn't join by pressing Shift-Tab and joining the game from the friends tab from Steam, the only way is or to download so crap program to connect your pc's to show on lan, idk i didnt tried that, the only way was to open console and connecting with ip that actually work, but after the game had to change map, everyone except the host was disconnected and had to do the whole proccess again. Now on story mode most of the time i had to search the walkthrough on youtube to solve some very confussing puzzles without explanations, another problem, why the hell the game doesn't allow you to adjust the brightness on the options, for the gamma i could but for the brightness always was on the lowest, i had to adjust the brightness from the nvidia settings and my monitor so i could barely still see. Really sad to see this game so problematic.

cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Long-term players encounter engine instability during extended sessions, requiring community patches to maintain stability alongside complex backtracking.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game is unstable during prolonged play due to its age and design for older hardware, leading to crashes.

citations.review_text:
My favorite survival horror game on the Gold Source engine. It's like an early 2000's game, at least it feels like what the game was going for. Cry of Fear executes tension very well and represents depression uncensored with its guts spilling out. The environments are dark and cramped, allowing for monsters to get close and personal with you, which I liked about the level design.

I do wish to warn you however: this game doesn't like modern systems and crashes with prolonged use unless you download the developer's 64 bit fix on ModDB. Why this isn't included in the Steam download is a mystery to me. I managed without it anyway, just remember this if you experience crashes or have issues loading.

[h3]Pros:[/h3][list]
[*] Great tension, OST, and atmosphere. Understands quality horror doesn't mean only jumpscares.
[*] Intriguing story from an era unconcerned about reaching the masses (uncensored views on depression).
[*] Plenty of weapons to use and environments to explore.
[*] Simon while not a beacon of a role model, came across as a realistic character both in his vocal performances and troubles. I liked playing as him and going through his journey in the game; I'd wish him well.
[*] Praiseworthy improvements on the Gold Source engine, it really pushed it to the farthest.[/list]

[h3]Cons:[/h3][list]
[*] Can feel old school confusing and/or difficult at times without consulting a walkthrough. Has backtracking a lot.
[*] Multiplayer server browser has been broken for years and needs extra time to figure out how to play the co-op.
[*]Occasional 64-bit performance dips and crashes if you play for too long (but has an off-Steam developer fix on ModDB).[/list]

It may feel a little slow to start with, but for me it was worth playing through both the campaign and co-op epilogue. I never played this genre before and thought it was a good introduction to it. Cry of Fear is free, and I can say it was worth my time experiencing. 9/10.

The game is free. The only problem of the game is it's designed for older hardware so it's a bit unstable playing it for a prolonged time though it's mostly fixed by "Morphine Launcher" and few level designs, especially the chapter 1 maps. Story wise, this kind of story isn't really present on any games I have tried (Except Afraid of Monsters, which is the developed by the same team) and I wish i could play this for the first time again. For combat, it's much different from Half Life and it features a dodge mechanic and is quite unique. My tip. Go in blind and look out for light sources just shining into random things such as TVs. The game is pretty dark which helps with the atmosphere and constantly fills you with dread so in your first playthrough I highly recommend you to not increase the brightness.

Aside from the fact that it took place in my beloved Stockholm, and had a great soundtrack and aesthetic, it was a waste of time. I love psychological horror but this wasn’t it. claims.claim: Reviewers describe enemy attack animations as out of sync, causing damage to register before the animation finishes.

citations.review_text: While i like this game and a lot, i would not recommend it to others, the hand to hand combat is specially not very fun, the attack animation of the enemies are not synced correctly and they deal damage before the animation ends, the horror elements while interesting and likeable, are somewhat superficial at presenting their symbolism and unless you watch or read an explanation they aren't presented properly. The graphics are absolutely gorgeous for a Gold Source game and the atmosphere is well built, some of the levels and puzzles are a bit weird from a design standpoint and. Some of them get very tedious after a second playthrough. A diamond in the rough, a little overrated but still a very good game and even with its flaws makes an unforgettable experience.
